title: Bigg Boss Telugu 10: Two Families Seek Out Trigun in Family Week

 Two visiting families in the Bigg Boss Telugu 10 house stopped to talk to the same housemate, Trigun, and neither family was his own.
 Family week began in the Bigg Boss Telugu 10 episode reported on Wednesday, 11 November, with relatives of Naresh, Shweta and Vamsi entering the house. Every contestant except captain Vamsi is nominated this week, so each word a visitor says on camera reaches voters as they decide who stays.
 Naresh's brother Suresh came in first. Bigg Boss said this was deliberate: Naresh had lost his chance to meet family in an earlier challenge, keeping his word and giving way to other contestants. Suresh hugged his brother, sat with Naresh and Ram Prasad to talk about how to play, spoke privately with Debjani and shared a meal with Naresh.
 Shweta's sister arrived next, then her father. Shweta held him and wept, told him how Trigun had been supporting her, and her father went to speak with Trigun himself.
 Context and Official Statements
 The visits followed a school task. Naresh became principal and English teacher, Shweta took art and PT, Neetu dance, Debjani Telugu and Varshini chemistry, while the rest sat as students in uniform.
 Vamsi's daughter was the first of his family to enter. He hugged her and cried, cooked for her himself and showed her the captain's room. His wife came in after that.
 She said the most about the game. She thanked Trigun for supporting her husband, greeted him as "bro" and, speaking in Telugu, told him everyone should have a friend like him and praised how thoughtfully he was playing. Trigun also played with Vamsi's daughter.
 Each family was given a food ring task, tossing rings onto food items that Bigg Boss then sent to the housemates.
 Krihaa Analysis
 The tears made the episode, but the detail that matters for the vote is who the families chose to talk to. Trigun is not captain, so he is nominated. Yet he featured in two of the three visits: Shweta's father sought him out, and Vamsi's wife praised him on camera.
 Vamsi is safe this week, so his supporters have no one of his to save. A thank-you from his wife tells that audience where his alliance lies, and Trigun is the obvious beneficiary. Shweta's account to her father points the same way for her viewers.
 The show's own framing counts too. By sending Naresh's brother first and calling it a reward for sacrifice, Bigg Boss gave Naresh a sympathetic edit in a nomination week.
 Still unknown is which families enter next and whether they repeat the pattern. The test comes at this week's eviction: if Trigun finishes safely while others in the Vamsi and Shweta circle do not, family week will have worked as a campaign.
